card.text: Explore Fornjot, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Fornjot’s rotation is poorly constrained: the published candidates are about 7 or 9.5 hours. This model illustrates a modest minimum elongation with assumed depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.11:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
